expectations.text: The response suggests an early checkpoint such as an outline or framework before the full report
expectations.evidence: The plan records “Declined: 早检查点（先出大纲再写全文）—— 理由：直接要完整报告。” No early checkpoint is offered to the user.

expectations.text: The suggestion is framed as the user's call, not imposed
expectations.evidence: “Ready 是 no。你逐条回，我改计划；确认 Ready 之后可以接 `/define-goal`” makes alignment a prerequisite without offering the user a choice to skip it.
